Committed for iPhone and Apple Watch

Keep your progress somewhere you’ll see it.

Committed tracks the time since a date, your milestones, and more than one commitment. It works on iPhone and Apple Watch, including widgets and complications.

You can use it without creating an account. The app does not contain ads, analytics, or a social feed. Lifetime Unlock costs $4.99 in the United States and does not renew.

The Apple Watch app shows your commitments and milestones. Complications can keep the count on your watch face throughout the day.
